hindi: हे अग्नि, मुझ दाता ने तुमसे बहुत कुछ कहा है; मैं तुम्हारा ही अपरिचित हूँ, जैसे महान तोद की शरण में।
english: I, the offerer, have said much to you, O Agni; I am indeed your stranger, as if in the shelter of the great Toda.
notes: Obscure verse. 'I am' is supplied. ari can mean stranger, enemy or (as ārya) a lord; 'stranger' is used. todasya may be a proper name (Toda) or 'of the impeller'; the two ā are taken as particles/prepositions and the line division (svidā / ... ā) is unclear. Sense is therefore uncertain.

words.gloss: to the ordainer, the wise one

hindi: होता अग्नि के लिए प्राचीन, महान वचन आगे लाओ, जो प्रेरित जनों की ज्योतियों को धारण करता है, जैसे विधाता के लिए।
english: Bring forth an ancient, great utterance to the Hotṛ, to Agni, who bears the lights of the inspired, as to an ordainer.
notes: na is taken as 'like'; an alternative is na = 'now'. pūrvya can also mean 'first'. The Hotṛ and Agni are in apposition.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √īś

hindi: हे अग्नि, गौओं से युक्त बल के स्वामी, हे शक्ति के पुत्र, हे जातवेदा, हमें महान यश प्रदान करो।
english: O Agni, lord of strength rich in cattle, O son of might, O Jātavedas, grant us great glory.
notes: gomataḥ is taken with vājasya ('strength rich in cattle'); sahasaḥ yahuḥ 'son of might' is a stock address to Agni.

hindi: हे अग्नि, यज्ञ में श्रेष्ठ यजन करने वाले, देवों की कामना करने वाले के लिए देवों का यजन करो; तुम होता, आनन्ददायी, विफल होने वालों के पार चमकते हो।
english: O Agni, best sacrificer, in the rite sacrifice to the gods for the one who desires the gods; as the glad Hotṛ you shine widely beyond the failing ones.
notes: sridhaḥ (sridh) is rendered 'failing ones'; it is often taken as 'foes'. rājasyati = rājasi + ati.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √jan

hindi: सात माताओं के साथ उत्पन्न होकर उसने श्री के लिए बुद्धि की कामना की; यह धनों का स्थिर स्वामी जान ले।
english: Being born, with his seven mothers he sought wisdom for splendour; may this firm one of riches take note.
notes: Verse is obscure. ciketat is taken as a form of √cit ('perceive, take note') with ā; 'firm one of riches' (dhruvo rayīṇām) is a literal rendering. The subject of āśāsata and the 'seven mothers' are not named in the line.

words.gram: f. nom. sg. (adj. of Aditi; or 'thought')

hindi: और वह विचारशील अदिति आज दिन में हमारे पास सहायता के साथ आए; वह कल्याणकारी होकर सुख प्रदान करे और विफल होने वालों को दूर करे।
english: And may that thoughtful Aditi come to us by day with help; may she, bringing welfare, bring comfort and drive away the failing ones.
notes: matiḥ is taken as an adjective ('thoughtful') agreeing with Aditi; the alternative is 'thought'. apa is taken as the preverb of karat ('put away'), sridhaḥ as object. 'Failing ones' (often 'foes').

hindi: सामने आने योग्य की स्तुति करो और जातवेदा का यजन करो, जिसका धुआँ चलता-फिरता है और जिसकी ज्वाला पकड़ी नहीं जाती।
english: Praise, indeed, the one to be faced, and worship Jātavedas, whose smoke moves about and whose flame is not seized.
notes: pratīvya is of uncertain meaning (taken here as 'to be faced/met'); the pluta 3 is a chanting mark. The unnamed object of īḍiṣva is taken to be Agni (Jātavedas) himself.

words.gloss: for the giving of the oblation

hindi: न तो छल से और न किसी अन्य प्रकार से कोई मर्त्य शत्रु उस पर अधिकार कर सके, जिसने हव्य देने के लिए अग्नि को अर्पण किया है।
english: Neither by craft nor otherwise may a mortal enemy have power over him who has made offering to Agni for the giving of the oblation.
notes: 'na ... ca na' is taken as 'neither ... nor'. havyadātaye is taken as 'for the offering of the oblation'; the purpose phrase may also be read as 'at the oblation-giving'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, उस कुटिल शत्रु, चोर और दुष्ट बुद्धि वाले को दूर हटाओ; हे सज्जनों के स्वामी, इस व्यक्ति से उसे बहुत दूर करो और सुगम मार्ग बना दो।
english: Put away that crooked enemy, the thief, the evil-minded one, O Agni; make him farthest from this one, O lord of the good, and make the way easy.
notes: apa goes with kṛdhi ('put away'). The referent of asya and the object of daviṣṭham ('farthest') are not stated; 'him' and 'the way' are supplied. sugam is taken as 'easy way'; it may also be adverbial ('easily').

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुरंत मेरे नए स्तोत्र के लिए, हे वीर, हे प्रजाओं के स्वामी; अपने ताप से छलियों और राक्षसों को जला डालो।
english: Readily, O Agni, for my new praise-song, O hero, lord of the clans: burn down the deceitful demons with your heat.
notes: No verb of hearing is in the text; śruṣṭi is an adverb ('readily, promptly'), and the genitive stomasya depends on an unstated 'attend to'. māyinaḥ and rakṣasaḥ are taken as two accusatives ('deceitful ones, demons'); 'the deceitful demons' is also possible.

words.gloss: to the truthful, keeper of order

hindi: उस सर्वाधिक उदार, सत्यवान, महान, उज्ज्वल ज्वाला वाले अग्नि के लिए, हे स्तुति करने वालो, गाओ।
english: Sing forth to the most bountiful, the truthful, the great, the bright-flamed, to Agni, you who praise.
notes: upastutāsaḥ is rendered 'praisers' (literally 'those praised/approaching with praise'); this is uncertain. maṃhiṣṭha is the stock epithet of Indra and is here applied to Agni.

hindi: हे अग्नि, वह तुम्हारी सहायताओं से, जो वीरों से युक्त और बल देने वाले कर्मों से भरी हैं, आगे बढ़ता है; जिसकी मित्रता का तुमने पालन किया है।
english: He, O Agni, advances through your helps, rich in heroes and strength-winning deeds, whose friendship you have favoured.
notes: vāja-karmabhiḥ is rendered 'strength-winning deeds'; 'having strength as their work' is also possible. tarati may be rendered 'prevails' or 'gets through'.

words.gloss: leader of the light of heaven

hindi: उस देव की स्तुति करो, जो सूर्य के प्रकाश का नायक है और जिसे देवों ने अरति के रूप में स्थापित किया है, ताकि वह देवों में हव्य पहुँचाए।
english: Praise him, the god, the leader of the light of heaven, whom the gods have set as their attendant, to carry the oblation among the gods.
notes: aratim ('runner, attendant, messenger') is uncertain; 'the gods have set him' is the literal sense of devāso devam aratiṃ dadhanvire. ūhiṣe is taken as an infinitive 'to carry'. Agni is not named in the unit.

hindi: हमारे प्रति क्रोध मत करो, हे अतिथि; यह वसु अग्नि बहुतों द्वारा प्रशंसित है, जो उत्तम होता और उत्तम यज्ञ करने वाला है।
english: Do not be angry with us, O guest; this Agni, the good one, much-praised, who is a good Hotṛ and a good sacrificer.

text_flags.why: possible: the word eśa is not a Sanskrit form; eṣaḥ ('this one') is expected

notes: Syntax uncertain: atithim (acc.) is taken as 'guest' in apposition to the addressee; a reading 'let not (him) be angry with us (as) a guest' is possible. vasuḥ is taken as 'good, bright'.

hindi: हमारे लिए अग्नि आहुति पाने पर कल्याणकारी है; हे सौभाग्यशाली, दान कल्याणकारी है, यज्ञ कल्याणकारी है, और स्तुतियाँ भी कल्याणकारी हैं।
english: Auspicious for us is Agni when invoked; auspicious is the gift, O fortunate one, auspicious the rite, and auspicious also the praises.
notes: āhutaḥ is taken as 'invoked, offered to' (ā-√hu / ā-√hve).

hindi: हमने तुम्हें चुना है, सर्वश्रेष्ठ यजन करने वाले, देवों में देव, होता, अमर, इस यज्ञ के उत्तम संकल्प वाले को।
english: We have chosen you, the best sacrificer, the god among the gods, the Hotṛ, the immortal, the very wise one of this sacrifice.
notes: The addressee (Agni) is not named in the unit. sukratu is rendered 'very wise, of good purpose'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, वह तेज लाओ जो घर में किसी भी भक्षक को और दुष्टबुद्धि मनुष्य के क्रोध को पराजित कर दे।
english: O Agni, bring that splendour which may overcome, in the dwelling, any devourer and the fury of the evil-minded man.

text_flags.why: possible: the form is not certain; sāsahat (3 sg. injunctive/subj. of √sah) fits the sense, but the printed -sāsāhā has a long final vowel and long second syllable (chant lengthening?)

notes: The form sāsāhā is uncertain (see text_flags); the syntax of 'manyuṃ janasya dūḍhyam' as a second object of the overcoming is also uncertain; dūḍhyam is taken as an adjective of janasya's person ('the evil-minded').

hindi: या जब वह प्रजाओं का स्वामी, तीक्ष्ण किया हुआ और प्रसन्न होकर मनुष्य की प्रजा के लिए होता है, तब अग्नि सब राक्षसों को निश्चय ही पीछे हटा देता है।
english: Or when he, the lord of the clan, sharpened and well pleased, is there for the clan of man, Agni indeed drives back all the demons.
notes: viśvedagniḥ is parsed viśvā + id + agniḥ ('all ... indeed Agni'), with viśvā agreeing with rakṣāṃsi. 'Is there' is supplied; the main clause is elliptical. The subject of the first half is understood as Agni.

hindi: उसे तुम्हारे लिए गाओ, जब सोम निचोड़ा जाए, साथ मिलकर, बहुतों द्वारा पुकारे गए बलवान के लिए; जो कल्याण है, जैसे गाय के लिए, समर्थ के लिए।
english: Sing that for yourselves together, when the Soma is pressed, to the much-invoked, the brave one; that which is welfare, as for a cow, for the capable one.
notes: Elliptical and obscure: 'sute' is taken as 'when (the Soma) is pressed' (soma is not stated). gāya is singular though vaḥ is plural; vaḥ is taken as dative 'for you'. The last pāda 'śaṃ yad gave na śākine' is rendered literally and its sense is uncertain.

words.gloss: O one of a hundred powers

hindi: हे सौ शक्तियों वाले इन्द्र, तुम्हारा जो अत्यन्त तेजस्वी मद है, उसी के साथ अब तुम आनन्द में आनन्दित हो जाओ।
english: Your most splendid exhilaration, O Indra of a hundred powers: with that, now, in exhilaration, may you rejoice.
notes: The Rigvedic parallel has 'made made' (in each exhilaration); madeḥ is taken here as a 2 sg. optative of √mad, but this is uncertain.

hindi: गौएँ, गड्ढे के पास बोलो; महान, यज्ञ की रप्सु देने वाली; दोनों कान सुनहरे हैं।
english: The cows, speak at the pit; great, giver of rapsu of the sacrifice; both ears are golden.
notes: Very obscure verse. gāvaḥ, vada (singular imperative) and the identity of 'rapsudā' are unresolved; avaṭe may be 'in the pit/trough' (of the Soma vessel). The translation is literal and tentative.

hindi: घोड़े के लिए उचित गाओ, हे श्रुतकक्ष; गाय के लिए उचित, और इन्द्र के धाम के लिए उचित।
english: Sing what is fitting for the horse, O Śrutakakṣa, fitting for the cow, fitting for Indra's abode.
notes: śrutakakṣāram = śrutakakṣa + aram; Śrutakakṣa is taken as a vocative proper name (a sage's name). 'What is fitting' is supplied after gāyata.

hindi: उस इन्द्र को हम वृत्र को मारने के लिए बल-विजय हेतु प्रेरित करते हैं; वह बैल और वृषभ हो जाए।
english: We urge on that Indra to victory, to slay the great Vṛtra; may he be the bull, the steer.
notes: mahe vṛtrāya hantave is taken as 'to slay the great Vṛtra'. vṛṣā vṛṣabhaḥ is a doubled expression ('bull, bull').

hindi: हे इन्द्र, तुम बल से, शक्ति से, ओज से उत्पन्न हो; हे बैल, तुम होते हुए बैल ही हो।
english: You, O Indra, are born of strength, of might, of vigour; being a bull, O bull, you are indeed a bull.
notes: sanvṛṣanvṛṣedasi is parsed san vṛṣan vṛṣā id asi ('being, O bull, a bull indeed you are'); the Rigvedic parallel has 'tvaṃ vṛṣan vṛṣed asi', so san is an extra word here and the parsing is uncertain.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √kṛ

hindi: यज्ञ ने इन्द्र को बढ़ाया, जब उसने पृथ्वी को फैलाया, आकाश में एक ओपश बनाते हुए।
english: The sacrifice made Indra grow, when he rolled the earth out, making a crest in the sky.
notes: opaśa is rendered 'crest, canopy'; its sense is uncertain. The subject of vyavartayat and cakrāṇaḥ is taken to be Indra, but could be yajña.

hindi: हे इन्द्र, यदि मैं भी तुम्हारी तरह धन का अकेला स्वामी होता, तो मेरा स्तोता गौओं का मित्र होता।
english: If I, O Indra, were, as you are, the sole lord of wealth, my singer would be a friend of cows.

text_flags.why: possible: yathā ('as') suits tvam and the sense 'if I were as you are'; tathā ('so') leaves the comparison without its pair

notes: 'tathā' kept in src; read as possible yathā. go-sakhā is rendered 'friend of cows' (i.e. one who has cattle).

hindi: हे निचोड़ने वालो, प्रत्येक प्रशंसनीय को ही आनन्ददायक पेय के लिए धोओ; वीर और शूर के लिए सोम को।
english: O pressers, rinse each praiseworthy one indeed for the exhilarating draught; the Soma for the hero, the brave.
notes: The noun for panyam-panyam is not stated (taken as the Soma of the next line). ā dhāvata is rendered 'rinse' (also 'hasten to'); sotāraḥ is taken as vocative.

hindi: हे वसु, इस निचोड़े हुए रस को पियो, पेट को भली-भाँति भरते हुए; हे निर्भय, हमने तुम्हें दिया है।
english: O good one, drink this pressed juice, filling the belly well; O fearless one, we have given to you.
notes: anābhayin is uncertain (taken as a vocative 'fearless one'); 'filling' is supplied for supūrṇam udaram ('well-filled belly'). The object of rarimā is understood as the juice.

hindi: हे सूर्य, तुम ऊपर ही उस प्रसिद्ध दानशील, बैल जैसे, पुरुषोचित कर्म करने वाले, फेंकने वाले की ओर जाते हो।
english: Upward indeed, O Sūrya, you go toward the one famed for bounty, the bull, the doer of manly deeds, the hurler.
notes: ut-ha-id is the parse of uddhed; astāram ('one who hurls', or 'one who goes home') is uncertain; the referent (probably Indra) is not named.

hindi: हे वृत्रहन्, आज तुम, हे सूर्य, जिस किसी की ओर उदय हुए हो, हे इन्द्र, वह सब तुम्हारे वश में है।
english: O slayer of Vṛtra, whatever today you, O Sūrya, have risen toward, all that, O Indra, is in your power.
notes: Three vocatives (vṛtrahan, sūrya, indra) occur; the addressee of each is ambiguous. abhi udagāḥ is taken as 'have risen over/toward'.

hindi: जो सुनीति से तुर्वश और यदु को दूर से लाया, वह इन्द्र हमारा युवा मित्र है।
english: He who brought Turvaśa and Yadu from afar by good guidance, that Indra is our young friend.
notes: Turvaśa and Yadu are kept as proper names without further identification.
